workouts.name: Push Ups
workouts.instructions: Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels. Lower your chest until it almost touches the floor, then push back up.

workouts.name: Squats
workouts.instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Sit back into an imaginary chair while keeping your back straight and chest up.

workouts.name: Plank
workouts.instructions: Maintain a forearm plank position. Engage your core and glutes, keeping hips level without sagging.

workouts.name: Diamond Push Ups
workouts.instructions: Place hands close together forming a diamond shape below your chest. Lower down with elbows tucked in.

workouts.name: Pike Push Ups
workouts.instructions: Invert body into an A-shape position with hips high. Bend elbows lowering crown of head towards the ground.

workouts.name: Superman Hold
workouts.instructions: Lie face down on the mat. Simultaneously raise arms, chest, and legs off the ground, squeezing lower back.

workouts.name: Walking Lunges
workouts.instructions: Step forward with right leg, lowering hips until both knees are bent at a 90-degree angle. Alternate legs.

workouts.name: Bicycle Crunches
workouts.instructions: Lie on back, hands behind head. Touch right elbow to left knee while extending right leg. Switch side in a pedaling motion.

workouts.name: Leg Raises
workouts.instructions: Lie flat on your back. Keep legs straight and lift them towards the ceiling, then slowly lower without touching the floor.

workouts.name: Cat-Cow Stretch
workouts.instructions: On all fours, alternate arching your back upwards (Cat) and dipping your spine down while lifting chest (Cow).

workouts.name: Child Pose Hold
workouts.instructions: Kneel on mat, sit back on heels and extend arms forward on the floor. Breathe deeply and relax shoulders.

workouts.name: Cobra Stretch
workouts.instructions: Lie face down, place hands under shoulders and press up, extending arms to open chest and stretch abdominal wall.

workouts.name: Jumping Jacks
workouts.instructions: Jump feet out wide while swinging arms overhead, then jump back to starting position at a steady rhythmic pace.

workouts.name: Mountain Climbers
workouts.instructions: Start in a high plank position. Alternately drive knees towards chest rapidly as if running in place.

workouts.name: High Knees
workouts.instructions: Run in place driving knees up to hip height rapidly while pumping arms.

workouts.name: Burpees
workouts.instructions: Drop into a squat, kick feet back into a push-up position, perform a push-up, jump feet forward and explosively leap up.

workouts.name: Russian Twists
workouts.instructions: Sit with knees bent, feet slightly off ground. Rotate torso left and right, touching ground on each side.

workouts.name: Jump Squats
workouts.instructions: Perform a standard squat, then explosively jump upwards extending legs fully before landing softly into next squat.

workouts.name: Standing Hamstring Stretch
workouts.instructions: Stand tall, hinge forward at hips with flat back, reaching towards toes to feel deep stretch along hamstrings.

workouts.name: Shoulder Overhead Stretch
workouts.instructions: Reach one arm overhead and bend elbow, pulling elbow gently with opposite hand behind head.

workouts.name: Deep Breathing Meditation
workouts.instructions: Sit comfortably in a quiet space. Inhale deeply for 4 seconds, hold for 4, exhale slowly for 6 seconds.
